name: Ghostly

pageNotLoaded.hint: Check your connection, then try again. If it still fails, reload Ghostly.
pageNotLoaded.title: This page did not load.

profileUnavailable.info: Nothing was changed or deleted. While closed, this profile connects to nobody and sends nothing. Ghostly {{app}} reads profile data up to version {{supported}}.
profileUnavailable.newerHint: Update the app to open it.
profileUnavailable.newerInfo: Its data is version {{stored}}; Ghostly {{app}} reads up to {{supported}}. Nothing was opened, sent or changed: your chats, keys and wallets are still there.
profileUnavailable.newerTitle: This profile was last used by a newer version of Ghostly.
profileUnavailable.noUpdate: No newer version is out yet. Open this profile with the app that used it last.

reason.blocked: Another Ghostly window or tab still has it open with an older version.
reason.denied: This browser gives Ghostly no storage here: a private window, or storage blocked for this site.
reason.failed: The data did not open, and the system gave no clear reason.
reason.full: This device is out of storage space.

profileUnavailable.title: Ghostly could not open this profile's data.

try.blocked: Close the other Ghostly windows and tabs, then try again.
try.denied: Use a normal window or allow storage for this site, then try again.
try.failed: Restart the app or the device, then try again.
try.full: Free some space, then try again.
